title: Hitman 2: Silent Assassin
notes: Each mission's achievement unlocks when the next mission starts loading.
Read-only: Vault watches the game's memory and never changes it.
Addresses come from the community speedrun auto-splitters for the Steam version.
Save achievements come from the save games in the Save folder: each one names the mission it was made in. Saving is limited on harder difficulties and impossible on Professional.

testGuide.title: Start Hitman 2: Silent Assassin
testGuide.detail: Start or load a mission. "Current scene number" should show a number that changes between missions.

testGuide.title: Finish a mission
testGuide.detail: When the next mission loads, that mission's achievement should pop up. If not, send a test report.
